Now I see the issue. In `constructXRef`, when a new entry is created, it sets `offset`, `gen`, and `type`, but it does NOT set `flags`. The `flags` field is left uninitialized. Then when `Parser::makeStream` calls `entry->setFlag(XRefEntry::Parsing, true)`, it reads the uninitialized `flags` field.
